acceptance.reference: Independent full-float64-kernel actions and direct cross kernels at finite probes; all-query comparisons to an audited regional cache where recorded. No uniform exact-GP certificate.

timing: Includes all production setup, mean and variance preparation, final query replay. Excludes common synthetic input generation, common runtime warmup, and independent verification. SDD additionally excludes rejected checkpoints/projection alternatives and uses offline stopping selection.
limitations: Synthetic noisy-normal partial scans; positions are exact.
Query region is observed contact, not missing scan boundary.
Deterministic mean-level anchoring is not scalar-contact conditioning.
Constant contact variance passes the CDF gate but fails the spatial-variance gate.
Hard distance truncation is not a PSD-preserving taper.
Largest Cholesky factor does not fit; no runtime extrapolation.
SDD timing is best tested checkpoint, not exhaustive tuning.
H2 rank/iteration boundedness and asymptotic superiority remain conditional.
Mixed-precision H2/sparse and bounded-memory locality controls remain open in issue 87.
